ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the map of a certain region of our country; the arrows in the map indicate the directions of population movement currently taking place. <image1> What is the main reason causing the population movement in the map?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the map is labeled with “Danjiangkou Reservoir”; the reservoir is located in the lower-left part of the map; many arrows in the map point from near the reservoir or around the reservoir area toward external regions, indicating that the population is migrating outward from the reservoir area. Then reason: the question stem states that the arrows indicate the “directions of population movement currently taking place”; this kind of migration outward from the reservoir area is not ordinary seasonal population movement, but better fits reservoir-area migrant resettlement caused by reservoir and related water conservancy engineering construction. Danjiangkou Reservoir is also related to major projects such as the Middle Route of the South-to-North Water Diversion Project, so the main reason causing the population movement in the map is engineering construction.
